text:
ana: FYI pushed a preview for 'runtime-key-pruner' that flags config keys with zero runtime lookups in the last 90 days. Want ops/telemetry/UX eyes before we enable deletes.

kevin: Nice. A few constraints: (1) exclude keys <60d old, (2) honor explicit `no-auto-prune` label, (3) owner resolution needs audit fallback.

ana: ack and noted (typo: ana). We'll exclude <60d and add a 'young-unused' category for 30-60d. `no-auto-prune` will be respected. Owner source: metadata.owner -> audit.creator -> platform-ops inbox. We'll attach resolution trace.

ops-bot: [job] runtime-key-pruner.preview started: run=rkpreview-2024-06-01T10:00Z :gear:

mike: Telemetry: emit a sampled preview stream so owners can review diffs. Proposed events: `rkpruner.preview.start`, `rkpruner.preview.sample`, `rkpruner.preview.summary`. Include owner, last_seen, lookups_90d, created_at, labels. Also add metrics `rkpruner.candidates_total` and `rkpruner.pending_by_owner`.

ux: UX request: Console should show an "At-risk Keys" banner on key page with a 7-day reclaim CTA and link to the diff. Provide bulk-review modal for service owners and an email digest during preview. CTA text: "Reclaim key (7d)".

lina: Ops asks for two safeguards: snapshot pre-delete + tombstone 14d, and pre-delete smoke restores to validate snapshots. Also require ops approval for first production deletes.

ana: Plan summary: 1) preview-only runs emit sampled telemetry + diff export; 2) Console banners + bulk modal + one-click safelist; 3) `no-auto-prune` label prevents deletion; 4) keys <60d excluded from deletion, 30-60d flagged as young-unused; 5) deletion gated on snapshot + 14d tombstone + ops approval; 6) staged rollout: canary account -> 10% tenants -> all.

kevin: Scale notes: do cursored scans by shard, maintain a watermark to avoid full-table scans, and cap initial rate to 5k keys/hour. Also include exponential backoff on transient store errors.

mike: Example preview payload (sampled channel):

```
{
  "event": "rkpruner.preview.sample",
  "key": "billing.early_failover.enabled",
  "owner": "billing-service",
  "created_at": "2023-07-11T09:00:00Z",
  "last_seen": "2023-09-02T17:30:00Z",
  "lookups_90d": 0,
  "labels": ["experiment"]
}
```

ux: We'll draft banner + modal copy in the PR. Also recommend showing a timeline on the key detail (created, last_seen, flagged_at, reclaim_deadline).

lina: Ops will add a runbook section: undelete steps, who to page, and restore verification. Also require an audit event `rkpruner.delete.executed` with operator id.

ana: PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/runtime-key-pruner/pull/7. Holding deletes until ops and devex thumbs and after a successful canary preview. Will run preview for 72h and then re-evaluate. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
